race.name: Gnome
race.shortfluff: Slight, sly tricksters of the Feywild who excel at avoiding notice

trait.name: Fey Origin
trait.description: Your ancestors were native to the Feywild, so your origin is fey instead of a natural.

trait.name: Master Trickster
trait.description: You can use the ghost sound wizard Cantrip power as an encounter power.

trait.name: Reactive Stealth
trait.description: If you have any cover or concealment when you make an Initiative check, you can make a Stealth check to become hidden.

trait.name: Trickster's Cunning
trait.description: You have a +5 racial bonus to saving throws against Illusion effects.

trait.name: Gnome Racial Power
trait.description: You gain the fade away racial power.

race.fluff: In the Feywild, the best way for a small creature to survive is to be overlooked. While suffering in servitude to the fomorian tyrants of the Feydark, gnomes learned to hide, to mislead, and to deflect —and by these means, to survive. The same talents sustain them still, allowing them to prosper in a world filled with creatures much larger and far more dangerous than they are.
Play a gnome if you want:
► to be curious, funny and tricky.
► to rely more on stealth and deception than on brute strength.
► to be a member of a race that favors the bard, sorcerer, and wizard classes.

power.title: Fade Away
power.fluff: You turn invisible in response to harm
power.section: Effect:You become invisible until the end of your next turn or until you attack, whichever comes first.

power.title: Ghost Sound
power.fluff: With a wink, you create an illusory sound that emanates from a distant location
power.section: Effect:You can produce nonvocal sounds such as the ringing of a sword blow, jingling armor, or scraping stone. If you produce a whisper, you can make it quiet enough that only creatures adjacent to the target can hear the words.

feature.name: Physical Qualities
feature.benefit: Gnomes are smaller even than halflings, rarely exceeding 4 feet in height. Apart from their size, they resemble elves or eladrin, with pointed ears and chiseled facial features such as high cheekbones and sharp jaws. They have a more wild look than eladrin do, though, particularly in the hair that sprouts from their heads in random directions. Some male gnomes sprout tufts of hair from their chins, but they otherwise lack body hair.

Gnome skin tone ranges from a ruddy tan through woody brown to rocky gray. Their hair can be virtually any color, from stark white to blond and various shades of brown to autumnal orange or green. Their eyes are glittering black orbs.

Gnomes are as long-lived as eladrin, living over 300 years, but they show more of the effects of age. A gnome over the age of 100 has gray or white hair and skin that shows the wrinkled and weathered lines of a century of laughter, but even the oldest gnome retains the strength and agility of youth.

feature.name: Playing a Gnome
feature.benefit: In quiet forests of the Feywild and remote woodlands in the world, gnomes live out of sight and mostly beneath the notice of larger races. Gnomes dwell in homes dug among the roots of trees, easily overlooked and cleverly concealed by camouflage and illusion. They are fond of the burrowing mammals that share their habitat, such as badgers, foxes, and rabbits, and have a sense of kinship with these small animals that share their forests.

Unobtrusiveness is a virtue among gnomes. They grow up on games of stealth and silence, in which the winner is the last to be discovered. An adult gnome who draws attention in a crowd is considered dangerously rude. Gnome folk heroes are not mighty warriors, but tricksters who slip out of captivity, play great pranks without being detected, or sneak past magical guardians. They deflect both aggression and attention with humor, and they guard their thoughts with friendly laughter.

Gnomes also value a quick mind and the ability to come up with a clever solution to any problem. They appreciate witty conversation, especially rapidfire repartee. They are inventive and resourceful, although they have little interest in or aptitude for the kind of technology found in human cities. They have an innate talent for magic and a love of illusion, music, poetry, and story.

subfeature.benefit: Gnome Charasteristics:Affable, clever, crafty, curious, funny, guarded, inconspicuous, inventive, secretive, sly, tricky
Male Names:Alston, Alvyn, Brocc, Eldon, Frug, Kellen, Ku, Nim, Orryn, Pock, Sindri, Warryn, Wrenn

feature.name: Sample Gnome Adventurers
feature.benefit: Three sample adventurers are described below. You can use these as inspiration for your own character.

subfeature.name: Kellen, Gnome Bard
subfeature.benefit: Kellen has a grim sense of humor and a ready blade. He was thrust unwillingly into an adventuring career when cyclopses raided his village and took him captive. He labored as a slave to a fomorian king for a decade before finally making his escape and fleeing the Feywild entirely.
Though he longs to return one day to free the members of his family he was forced to leave behind, fear of what awaits him in the Feywild keeps him in the world.

subfeature.name: Orla, Gnome Warlock
subfeature.benefit: Orla has lived in the world her entire life. She was born in a forest among elves, but an encounter in the forest one evening changed her life. She found herself face to face with a fey spirit of such power that she was unable to move or speak and could only acquiesce to its unspoken demands. Her life belongs to that spirit now, she knows.
She wields its power as a fey pact warlock, but she feels its desires and pursues its goals without fully understanding where they might lead her.

subfeature.name: Lilli, Gnome Ranger
subfeature.benefit: Lilli's parents left the Feywild soon after she was born, fleeing an assault by fomorians on the their fey home. As a result, she has had a feeling of longing, a desire to return to a place she has no memory of but that pulls at her soul.

While traveling the world in search of a fey ring or ancient portal that would take her home, she has been learning to fight. So that she can free her parents' home and welcome them back with a smile.

feature.name: Racial Utility Powers
feature.benefit: A gnome can choose any of the following powers instead of a class utility power of the same level.

power.title: Draw No Attention
power.fluff: Your ability to slip notice sometimes allows you to catch foes off-guard
power.section: Effect:You use your Stealth check modifier in place of your initiative check modifier for the triggering check.
Also, if you have the fade away racial power, you can use it as part of this power without meeting its normal trigger or spending an action.

power.title: Clever Workaround
power.fluff: Your fey perspective allows you to see through a foe's defenses.
power.section: Trigger:You would make an attack roll
Effect:The triggering attack hits if it hits the target's lowest defense. It still counts as targeting the original defense for other abilities and features.

power.title: Vanishing Act
power.fluff: You seem to dissolve into the shadows or moonlight, reappearing where they least expect you.
power.section: Effect:You teleport up to 5 squares and gain concealment until the start of your next turn.

If you have cover or concealment at the end of the teleport, you instead become invisible and can make a Stealth check to become hidden as part of this teleportation. If you only have cover or concealment against some creatures, you only become invisible to those creatures.

power.title: Misleading Double
power.fluff: At the moment of impact, your form shimmers and splits, and you step aside with a mocking laugh
power.section: Effect:You gain a +4 power bonus to all defenses against the triggering attack.
After the triggering attack has been resolved, you gain concealment until the end of your next turn, and can shift up to a number of squares equal to your [Intelligence or Charisma] modifier.

If you shifted, you create an illusory duplicate of yourself in the space you left. The duplicate occupies its space, lasts until the end of your next turn and has your defenses. It is immune to attacks against Will, and is destroyed if hit by any other attack.
The duplicate counts as an ally for the purposes of flanking for you and your allies. If you make an Illusion attack, you can have it originate from the duplicate's space.
